page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.16xlarge is an enhanced general-purpose virtual machine built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.9 GHz. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, the server allocates 256.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The dedicated CPU assignment guarantees consistent processing capacity without multi-tenant contention on core cycles.

Network and input/output infrastructure features a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, supporting steady data exchange across distributed cloud environments. The instance does not bundle local disk storage, necessitating remote cloud block storage for persistent data requirements. In addition, it includes no hardware accelerators or GPUs, and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, focusing purely on general compute and memory capability.

Because of its 64-core density and proportional 256.0 GB memory footprint, the ecs.g7se.16xlarge is aligned with horizontal application clustering, large Java runtimes, container orchestration nodes, and distributed message broker workloads. The absence of local disk requires consideration of network storage latency, but the configuration delivers efficient resource utilization for multi-threaded tasks that require substantial host memory and dedicated compute throughput.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.16xlarge is a dedicated general-purpose instance designed for compute- and memory-balanced enterprise workloads. Operating on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture, it is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz with 64 dedicated vCPUs. The platform provides 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a consistent 4.0 GB per core ratio. Networking performance includes a baseline bandwidth capacity of 16 Gbps. The instance provides no integrated local disk storage, depending completely on external cloud storage volumes, and does not include GPU acceleration hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. With high core density and balanced memory allocation, the ecs.g7se.16xlarge is configured for large multi-threaded enterprise services, middle-tier application servers, relational database management systems backed by network storage, and containerized deployment fleets requiring steady, unconstrained CPU performance across all 64 cores.
